verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no named detection capability for AI-generated faces, deepfakes, or camera-injection attacks. Document-alteration detection (field-level edit highlighting) and session/device linking with a CLEAN/FRAUD verdict are adjacent fraud controls, not biometric anti-spoofing defenses, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to an identity-verification vendor, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the vendor documents specific defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes, and camera-injection attacks — named detection capabilities, not just a marketing mention of fraud
